Title: New features in Azure Cosmos DB Jupyter notebooks are now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB Jupyter notebooks has several new features available that make it easier for developers and data scientists to analyze and visualize their Azure Cosmos DB data. 

Among these new features is the ability to bulk upload data into a container with a single line %%upload command, use the integrated nteract data explorer for quick, built-in visualizations, and use the %%sql command to run any query against Azure Cosmos DB, including queries that contain a GROUP BY or VALUE clause. There are also new sample notebooks in the gallery to explain Azure Cosmos DB concepts and help you get started with the Azure Cosmos DB APIs for Cassandra and Gremlin API. 

Enable notebooks today and try out these new features with your Azure Cosmos DB account.
